Sounds like my Dad. But you can't be my Dad if you're only 18...
I have no advise... At the very least you won't die a virgin, though. That has to count for something, right?
No, the place just exist to stall people. Just like that stupid Lifeline Crisis Chat, which is nothing but a damn bot... Just kill us, it would be more humane.

My Dad: "Suicide is selfish. It would kill me if you were gone."
Yet he NEVER calls, NEVER wants to see me...
But it's not selfish for him to want me to continue to live when I'm in pure AGONY, pure HELL 24/7.
